**FOR EDUCATORS**

# Bring programming into your mathematics classroom.

Explore teaching materials, practical
guidance, and approaches to integrating
computational thinking into university
mathematics education.

Whether you're new to programming
or already use computational methods,
CTM aims to support your teaching.

:::

## Supporting Computational Thinking

Programming can be a powerful
tool for exploring mathematical ideas.

However, computational thinking
involves more than writing code.

It includes identifying problems,
developing algorithms, evaluating
solutions, and connecting computational
results with mathematical reasoning.

CTM aims to support educators
in integrating these approaches
into university mathematics teaching.

:::


::: {.ctm-section .ctm-section-light}

## Teaching in the Age of AI

Generative AI tools introduce
new possibilities and challenges
for programming education.

How should students develop
computational thinking when AI
can generate code?

How can educators assess mathematical
understanding in an AI-supported
learning environment?

Explore these questions and
their implications for teaching.

[Explore AI & Education](ai.qmd){.ctm-button}

:::


::: {.ctm-section}

## About the CTM Project

CTM brings together universities
across Europe to explore approaches
to computational thinking and
programming in mathematics education.
